svg.title: Team radio
svg.desc: NOW BUILDING: The finance system for the NUS Entrepreneurship Society: tiered approvals and an audit trail nobody can edit. ON TRACK: whatsthisposition.com has reviewed 3,034 games. Stockfish runs in each visitor's browser, not on a server. LOOKING FOR: AI/ML internships, research ideas and hackathon teams. Problems that need a model, not a demo.
